pack_metadata.title: Reusable Central-Government Identity and Registration Foundations
pack_metadata.user_outcome: Establish and maintain only the national identifiers, portal identities and signature bindings that downstream business, employment, trade and public-procurement journeys actually require.
pack_metadata.central_scope: India Central Government foundations: Aadhaar/contact readiness, PAN, TAN, GST registration account, licensed DSC/eSign, IEC, ICEGATE registration and IEC-GSTIN/DSC linkage, EPFO establishment/signatory/member setup, and Udyam Registration.
explicit_exclusions: No decision that a person is liable for GST, TDS/TCS, EPFO coverage or eligible for MSME status; the consuming journey must decide that first.
No GST returns, TDS/TCS statements, customs declarations, IEC authorisations, EPFO contribution filings, tender bids, MCA forms or GeM transactions.
No state or local registrations, professional tax, shops and establishments, factory licensing or state labour-law routes.
No universal bank-account-opening workflow; regulated-bank onboarding varies by entity and bank, so only account proof is modelled as an input.
No assumption that Aadhaar, DSC, GSTIN, IEC, ICEGATE, UAN or Udyam is universally required.
No private intermediary, consultant or unofficial registration site.

qualifying_questions.question: Does each proposed signatory or member have a valid Aadhaar with access to the registered mobile/email channel required by the selected portal?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: Instant e-PAN, GST Aadhaar authentication, DGFT Aadhaar eSign, EPFO eSign/UAN face authentication and Udyam can stop when Aadhaar identity or contact access is not ready.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: No or Unknown blocks only the Aadhaar-dependent path; preserve a non-Aadhaar alternative only where a current official portal explicitly offers it.

qualifying_questions.question: Who needs the PAN: Indian individual, Indian non-individual entity, foreign individual, foreign entity, or nobody because a valid PAN already exists?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: Income-tax Rules 2026 use Forms 93, 94, 95 and 96 respectively, while corrections use CR-01 or CR-02.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: Unknown blocks PAN application and every dependent registration. Never apply for a second PAN when one already exists.

qualifying_questions.question: Has a competent tax assessment determined that this person/entity must deduct or collect tax, file TDS/TCS statements, or issue TDS/TCS certificates?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: TAN is a conditional withholding-tax identifier, not a general business identifier and not interchangeable with PAN.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: Only Yes enables the TAN task. Unknown requires tax-owner review; this pack does not decide statutory withholding liability.

qualifying_questions.question: Has the consuming journey established a verified basis for mandatory or voluntary GST registration, and in which State/UT and taxpayer type?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: GST registration is State/UT and taxpayer-type specific; liability thresholds and exceptions must not be inferred by this reusable pack.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: No verified basis, State/UT and taxpayer type means no happy-path GST registration task.

qualifying_questions.question: What is the applicant constitution and which signature mode does the live GST form offer to its authorised signatory?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: Official GST materials conflict on whether companies/LLPs must use DSC or may use EVC; the live form must control.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: Do not purchase or omit a DSC based solely on dated GST guidance; record the live form option and retain the conflict gate.

qualifying_questions.question: Will the entity import/export goods, or export services/technology while claiming Foreign Trade Policy benefits?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: IEC is generally mandatory for goods trade, with specific exemptions; service/technology exports need IEC for FTP benefits under the stated condition.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: Unknown or a claimed exemption requires confirmation against current DGFT procedure before enabling IEC or ICEGATE tasks.

qualifying_questions.question: Which ICEGATE role is actually needed: IEC holder/authorised person, employee child user, Customs Broker role, logistics role, SEZ role, or none?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: Registration fields, approving actor and supporting licences differ by role; role registration is not interchangeable.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: Unknown blocks registration. This pack gives a verified IEC-holder spine but does not invent role-specific licence evidence.

qualifying_questions.question: Which live consuming portal and transaction requires a DSC rather than an EVC/eSign alternative?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: DSC class/type, signing versus encryption, token middleware and portal association are consumer-specific and volatile.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: No verified consumer requirement means no DSC procurement. A DSC does not become usable until the specific portal accepts and maps it.

qualifying_questions.question: Has EPFO coverage been established, and is the entity a new public/private limited company or OPC receiving registration through MCA SPICe+/AGILE-PRO?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: The normal Shram Suvidha route and the MCA incorporation route differ; public/private companies and OPCs cannot use the normal new-registration route stated by the portal.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: Coverage and route must both be verified before registration; voluntary coverage or notified establishments require separate legal review.

qualifying_questions.question: For each covered employee, does a UAN already exist and is it activated with accessible Aadhaar-linked mobile and face authentication?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: UAN is intended to persist across jobs; a duplicate must not be generated, and current allotment/activation is routed through UMANG face authentication.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: Unknown requires Know Your UAN/EPFO verification before generation. Never create a second UAN merely because employment changed.

qualifying_questions.question: Has the consuming journey established that the enterprise is eligible and wants Udyam Registration, and does its PAN/GST data reflect the same enterprise?
qualifying_questions.why_it_matters: Udyam is optional and benefit-oriented; classification is data-linked and this foundation pack does not decide eligibility.
qualifying_questions.blocking_logic: Only confirmed eligibility/want enables registration; Unknown is an action-required gate.

tasks.title: Verify Aadhaar and recover the registered contact channel
tasks.user_goal: Confirm that the Aadhaar identity and OTP channel needed by downstream portals are usable without exposing the Aadhaar number.
tasks.trigger: A downstream task will use Aadhaar authentication/eKYC/eSign or UAN face authentication.
steps: Use UIDAI My Aadhaar to verify the Aadhaar number and the registered mobile/email state.
If the mobile number is unavailable or incorrect, use a UIDAI Aadhaar Enrolment/Update Centre; mobile update is not an online-only path.
Retain only the verification/update reference, not OTPs or authentication secrets.
If rejected or unresolved, keep EID/URN/SRN and use UIDAI grievance channels including 1947.
tasks.tracking: Use the UIDAI status/grievance route with EID, URN or SRN as applicable.
tasks.rejection_handling: A submission does not guarantee an Aadhaar update. Follow the rejection reason; do not retry with inconsistent demographics.
tasks.escalation: UIDAI 1947, UIDAI grievance/feedback portal, then the relevant UIDAI Regional Office where instructed.

state_local_dependency.description: Aadhaar is a national identity service; physical centre availability is local but does not change the national rule.

tasks.fail_closed_note: An inaccessible OTP channel or demographic mismatch blocks only the Aadhaar-dependent branch; never mark downstream authentication complete from possession of an Aadhaar copy.

tasks.title: Obtain, correct or verify PAN
tasks.user_goal: Hold one valid PAN in the correct applicant category and prove its active status for dependent registrations.
tasks.trigger: A tax, GST, IEC, Udyam, employer or regulated onboarding journey requires PAN, or existing PAN details are wrong/inoperative.

fees_duties.label: Instant e-PAN
fees_duties.applicability: Only an eligible individual with no PAN, valid Aadhaar, Aadhaar-linked mobile and required DigiLocker access.

fees_duties.label: General PAN application
fees_duties.value: Mode/address/card-choice dependent; use the current fee table on the Income Tax PAN page
fees_duties.applicability: Protean/UTIITSL application; amount depends on paperless/physical mode, communication address and physical-card choice.

steps: First verify whether a PAN already exists; never use Instant e-PAN for a person already allotted PAN.
Choose Form 93, 94, 95 or 96 by applicant type, or CR-01/CR-02 for correction under the 2026 forms.
For an eligible no-PAN individual, use e-Filing homepage > Quick Links > Instant e-PAN > Get New e-PAN and complete Aadhaar/DigiLocker consent and OTP steps.
Otherwise use the official UTIITSL/Protean route or authorised PAN centre, submit the current form and prescribed identity/address/date evidence, and retain the acknowledgement.
Track on the same service-provider portal; after allotment/correction, use the Income Tax pre-login Verify PAN Status service.
tasks.tracking: Instant e-PAN uses Aadhaar OTP under Check Status/Download e-PAN; UTIITSL/Protean use their acknowledgement/reference number.
tasks.rejection_handling: Income Tax guidance says an incomplete/deficient general PAN application is invalid and requires a fresh correct application; Instant e-PAN failure routes to Protean/UTIITSL.
tasks.escalation: Use the selected authorised service-provider support; use Know Your JAO for Aadhaar-PAN delinking or jurisdictional issues identified by the Income Tax portal.

state_local_dependency.description: PAN is national; physical service-centre availability does not create a state rule.

tasks.fail_closed_note: A card image or application acknowledgement is not proof of active PAN. Require the allotted PAN plus a successful official status verification.

tasks.title: Obtain or correct TAN when withholding duties apply
tasks.user_goal: Hold the correct TAN for TDS/TCS compliance without confusing it with PAN.
tasks.trigger: A competent tax assessment confirms that the person/entity must deduct/collect tax, file TDS/TCS statements or issue certificates.

fees_duties.label: Protean TAN processing fee
fees_duties.applicability: Current Protean page for new TAN or change request; re-check at payment because fees are volatile.

timelines.label: Protean status enquiry availability
timelines.applicability: Status track using the 14-digit acknowledgement number.

steps: Confirm TAN is required; PAN cannot substitute where TAN is required, and do not apply again if TAN already exists.
Use Form 134 for a government entity or Form 135 for a non-government applicant under the 2026 rules.
Apply online at Protean or submit the signed form at a Protean TIN-FC; use the change/correction application for an allotted TAN.
Retain the 14-digit acknowledgement, track it on Protean, and verify allotted details with the Income Tax Know TAN Details pre-login service.
tasks.tracking: Protean Status Track with 14-digit acknowledgement; Know TAN Details is available pre-login on the Income Tax portal.
tasks.rejection_handling: Correct the category/responsible-person/address evidence and use the official change/correction route; do not create a duplicate TAN.
tasks.escalation: Protean TIN call centre/support, followed by the Income Tax jurisdiction/support route for allotment data issues.

state_local_dependency.description: TAN is a national income-tax identifier.

tasks.fail_closed_note: The task remains conditional on a separate TDS/TCS liability determination. A PAN does not satisfy a confirmed TAN requirement.

tasks.title: Create the GST registration account and obtain GSTIN
tasks.user_goal: Obtain the correct State/UT and taxpayer-type GST registration after a consuming journey establishes the legal basis.
tasks.trigger: A verified mandatory or voluntary registration basis, State/UT and taxpayer type have been supplied by a consuming journey.

timelines.label: Reply to REG-03 clarification notice
timelines.applicability: Where the proper officer issues FORM GST REG-03.

timelines.label: Aadhaar/biometric completion window
timelines.value: 15 days from the applicable registration event stated by the portal
timelines.applicability: Current GST Aadhaar FAQ; the effect differs for OTP and biometric/GSK paths.

steps: At gst.gov.in use Services > Registration > New Registration and complete Part A of REG-01 with PAN, mobile, email and State/UT to obtain the TRN.
Use TRN to complete Part B, entity/promoter/signatory/place-of-business/goods-services data and required uploads.

Follow the portal-selected Aadhaar path: OTP or GSK biometric/document verification when Yes is selected/risk-routed; GSK photo/document verification when No is selected, subject to stated exclusions.
At filing, use only the signature mode the live form offers to this applicant; retain the open DSC/EVC conflict gate.
Retain ARN/REG-02. If REG-03 is issued, reply electronically in REG-04 within the verified period and track the notice/ARN.
After approval, download REG-06 and validate GSTIN. Use core/non-core amendment routes for later changes; a PAN change requires fresh registration under the cited rule.
tasks.tracking: GST portal Services > Registration > Track Application Status using ARN; clarification can be accessed with TRN or logged-in saved applications as applicable.
tasks.rejection_handling: REG-03 is answered in REG-04. No reply or an unsatisfactory reply can lead to REG-05 rejection; use the stated reason and do not assume deemed approval.
tasks.escalation: GST portal help/grievance and jurisdictional proper officer; use the reference/ARN and retain all notices.

state_local_dependency.description: GST registration is State/UT specific and GSK/site-verification location may vary; this pack does not treat one State's fields as national.

tasks.fail_closed_note: Do not enable this task until liability/voluntary basis and jurisdiction are verified. The registration is not complete at TRN/ARN; require REG-06/GSTIN.

tasks.title: Obtain an appropriate CCA-licensed Digital Signature Certificate
tasks.user_goal: Acquire a DSC only after a live consuming portal establishes the required signer, assurance/type and signing/encryption need.
tasks.trigger: A current official consumer requires a DSC and does not offer a suitable eSign/EVC route.

fees_duties.label: DSC issuance/token price
fees_duties.applicability: Set by the selected licensed CA and product/validity; no universal government fee was verified.

timelines.label: Certificate validity
timelines.applicability: Use the actual certificate notBefore/notAfter and selected CA terms; do not invent a universal validity period.

steps: Record the consuming portal, transaction, authorised human signer, and whether signing and/or encryption is required.
Select a currently active licensed CA from CCA's public list; do not use an unlicensed reseller as evidence of certificate assurance.
Complete the CA identity-verification process for the appropriate Class 3 certificate and obtain the hardware cryptographic device where required.
Record certificate serial/subject/issuer/validity without retaining token PIN or private-key material.
If the key/token is compromised or the signer leaves the organisation, request revocation immediately and destroy the keys as applicable.
tasks.tracking: Track through the issuing licensed CA; validate certificate status using the chain and CRL/OCSP mechanism exposed by the CA/CCA framework.
tasks.rejection_handling: Resolve identity/organisation-authorisation deficiencies with the licensed CA; do not downgrade assurance or switch certificate type without the consumer's current requirement.
tasks.escalation: Licensed CA complaint route, then CCA for regulated-framework issues; compromise requires immediate CA revocation request.

state_local_dependency.description: India PKI is national; CA verification may be remote or location-dependent but does not create state law.

tasks.fail_closed_note: Do not procure from remembered 'Class 2' instructions or assume one certificate fits every portal. Never collect or store token PIN/private keys.

tasks.title: Bind DSC or choose the verified eSign/EVC alternative on each consumer portal
tasks.user_goal: Make the authorised signatory usable on MCA, GST, DGFT, ICEGATE, EPFO, CPPP or GeM without treating signature methods as interchangeable.
tasks.trigger: The specific portal requires signature association before a downstream form or bid.
steps: Confirm the live consumer's accepted method before association: token DSC, eSign or EVC.
MCA: login as Business User and use MCA Services > FO LLP Services > Associate DSC before signing a form.
ICEGATE: post-login use Services > Digital Signature Certificate > Register DSC; use Update DSC when the certificate changes.
EPFO: Employer Interface > Establishment > DSC/e-Sign and follow the authorised-signatory approval path.
CPPP: complete Online Bidder Enrollment, then enroll/map the e-token/DSC; verify the tender's signing/encryption requirement.
GST/GeM/DGFT: use only the method and middleware shown by the current transaction; retain portal confirmation as evidence.
Revoke/disable portal association when authorisation ends, and register a replacement before the next transaction.
tasks.tracking: Each portal's account/profile/signature area; no cross-portal registry proves all associations.
tasks.rejection_handling: Check PAN/name/role match, certificate validity, token middleware and authorised-signatory approval. Do not treat a valid CCA certificate as proof of portal mapping.
tasks.escalation: Use the consuming portal helpdesk with certificate metadata and error/reference, never token PIN or private key.

state_local_dependency.description: The named consumers are national portals; individual tendering authorities may add document conditions outside this foundation.

tasks.fail_closed_note: Signature mode is transaction-specific. GST materials conflict and current GeM signature details are not fully public; these branches require live portal confirmation.

tasks.title: Obtain or modify Importer-Exporter Code
tasks.user_goal: Create the DGFT IEC profile for an eligible trading entity and retain a verifiable IEC certificate.
tasks.trigger: Goods import/export is planned, or a service/technology exporter will claim FTP benefits, and no current exemption applies.

fees_duties.label: IEC application fee
fees_duties.applicability: Application for IEC under current DGFT Appendix 2K; verify at payment if the appendix changes.

steps: Confirm the IEC requirement or exemption under the current FTP/HBP before applying.
At dgft.gov.in register as Importer/Exporter using OTP-verified email/mobile and login.
Navigate My Dashboard > Importer Exporter Code (IEC) > Apply for IEC; complete entity, branch, PAN, address, bank and responsible-person details.
Sign using the live portal's accepted Aadhaar eSign or DSC path and pay the verified application fee.
Retain payment receipt and IEC certificate; use the QR/public IEC view or DGFT profile to validate it.
Use Update/Modify IEC rather than a new application when entity details change.
tasks.tracking: DGFT dashboard/application status and View IEC Profile; portal notifications are sent to registered mobile/email.
tasks.rejection_handling: Correct PAN/entity/bank/address or signature mismatches through the application/profile route; use DGFT Helpdesk for an unresolved application.
tasks.escalation: DGFT Helpdesk Service under IEC Profile Management, then the competent DGFT Regional Authority where the portal routes the case.

state_local_dependency.description: IEC is national; address verification can occur but is not a state registration.

tasks.fail_closed_note: Do not infer that IEC alone authorises restricted goods or satisfies product-specific NOCs, customs declarations or bank remittance requirements.

tasks.title: Annually confirm or update IEC details
tasks.user_goal: Keep IEC active by confirming current details even when nothing changed.
tasks.trigger: An IEC exists and the annual April-June update window occurs, or IEC is deactivated/flagged.

fees_duties.label: Annual IEC update during April-June
fees_duties.applicability: Update/confirmation during the stipulated April-June period.

fees_duties.label: Annual IEC update after stipulated period
fees_duties.applicability: Late annual update under current Appendix 2K.

timelines.label: Annual confirmation window
timelines.applicability: Every IEC holder, including no-change confirmation.

steps: Login to DGFT and open IEC Profile Management > Update/Modify IEC.
Review every profile field and bank/address/signatory linkage; confirm no change or submit corrections.
Sign and retain the successful update acknowledgement/profile snapshot.
If deactivated for non-update, complete the update to seek activation; if scrutiny-flagged, answer the specific risk request.
tasks.tracking: DGFT IEC lifecycle summary/profile status and dashboard notifications.
tasks.rejection_handling: Use Request Revoke Suspension/Request Revoke Cancellation only where applicable and address the stated cause; annual update alone may not cure unrelated action.
tasks.escalation: DGFT Helpdesk and the competent Regional Authority identified in the case.
tasks.fail_closed_note: A successful annual update can reactivate a non-updated IEC but does not override other suspension/cancellation or enforcement action.

tasks.title: Register the correct ICEGATE role and user hierarchy
tasks.user_goal: Obtain an approved ICEGATE ID for the verified customs role without borrowing another user's credentials.
tasks.trigger: A downstream customs service requires ICEGATE access and the user's role is known.
steps: At icegate.gov.in use Register Now or Services > Registration > Registration on ICEGATE.
Select the verified external-user role; for an IEC organisation distinguish parent IEC holder/authorised person from employee child users.
Enter identity and organisation fields that match PAN/IEC/DGFT/GSTN data and upload only the role-specific authorisation/licence evidence requested.
Register/sign with DSC where the live role form requires it and submit; retain the reference number.
Wait for departmental/parent approval. Approval credentials or rejection reason are sent to registered email under the official advisory.
Disable child users when their employment/authorisation ends and update contact/DSC through the post-login profile services.
tasks.tracking: Registration reference and registered email; use ICEGATE Registration Enquiry/verification where available and Ticket Management for unresolved cases.
tasks.rejection_handling: Use the emailed rejection reason to fix role, PAN/name, licence, authorisation or source-system contact mismatch; do not submit under a different role merely to bypass approval.
tasks.escalation: ICEGATE Ticket Management or 24x7 helpdesk 1800-3010-1000 with reference ID and non-secret metadata.

state_local_dependency.description: ICEGATE is national; customs-location/port codes are transaction or role attributes, not state registration.

tasks.fail_closed_note: A registration reference is not an approved ICEGATE ID. Role-specific fields are login/dynamic; require portal approval before dependent filing.

tasks.title: Map applicable GSTINs and register/update DSC on ICEGATE
tasks.user_goal: Align the customs account with the entity's IEC, applicable GSTINs and active signing certificate.
tasks.trigger: The entity has an approved ICEGATE ID and an applicable GSTIN that must be integrated/matched, or a DSC must be registered/updated.
steps: Use ICEGATE Services > Registration > Matching IEC GSTIN/Integrate GSTIN and enter the IEC/GSTIN requested by the live service.
Resolve source-system mismatches in DGFT or GSTN rather than overwriting with unsupported values.
Post-login use Services > Digital Signature Certificate > Register DSC or Update DSC as applicable.
Retain the portal confirmation and verify that the mapped GSTIN/active certificate appears in the ICEGATE profile.
tasks.tracking: ICEGATE profile/registration services and Ticket Management; public pages expose the service but full confirmation is post-login.
tasks.rejection_handling: Check IEC-PAN-GSTIN congruence and source-system contact data; escalate a true source mismatch rather than repeatedly remapping.
tasks.escalation: ICEGATE Ticket Management/helpdesk with the service reference; DGFT/GSTN remains the correction owner for its own master data.

state_local_dependency.description: GSTINs are State/UT registrations; map only the GSTIN(s) applicable to the customs use case.

tasks.fail_closed_note: The IEC-GSTIN matching service is publicly evidenced, but the current DSC registration/update path and accepted profile are login-gated. Do not put this combined task on a happy path; require separate live ICEGATE confirmations for mapping and any DSC binding.

tasks.title: Register the covered EPFO establishment through the correct route
tasks.user_goal: Obtain the establishment code/LIN only after coverage and incorporation route are determined.
tasks.trigger: The establishment is covered or approved for voluntary coverage and does not already have the required code.
steps: Confirm coverage and whether the entity is a new public/private limited company or OPC routed through MCA SPICe+/AGILE-PRO.
For other eligible establishments, create/login to Unified Shram Suvidha and choose Registration under EPFO Act or the applicable common EPFO-ESIC registration form.
Complete establishment, workplace, employer/contact, identifiers, employment/activity and attachment sections using current source documents.
For MCA-routed new companies/OPCs, use the incorporation-generated EPFO registration and do not duplicate it on Shram Suvidha.
Retain the registration number/LIN and validate the establishment in EPFO Establishment Search.
tasks.tracking: Shram Suvidha account/application dashboard and EPFO Establishment Search by name/code.
tasks.rejection_handling: Correct ownership/category, setup date, address, identifier or coverage evidence identified by the portal; do not bypass the MCA route split.
tasks.escalation: help-shramsuvidha@gov.in for portal registration; EPFO 14470/EPFiGMS or the mapped EPFO office for establishment master/coverage issues.

state_local_dependency.description: This task covers only central EPFO registration. State labour registrations and local establishment/factory licences used as evidence remain separate.

tasks.fail_closed_note: Headcount alone does not prove coverage in every case; notified establishment class, voluntary coverage and legacy codes require EPFO/legal verification.

tasks.title: Register the EPFO employer authorised signatory
tasks.user_goal: Enable an actually authorised employer representative to approve member/KYC actions with DSC or Aadhaar eSign.
tasks.trigger: An EPFO establishment exists and needs an authorised signatory for employer-interface actions.
steps: Login to the EPFO Employer Interface and navigate Establishment > DSC/e-Sign.
Choose Digital Signature Registration or e-Sign according to the live portal and authorised-signatory facts.
For eSign, provide VID/basic details and complete Aadhaar verification; generate, sign and upload the request letter when the portal requires it.
Confirm EPFO approval in the authorised-signatory view before using it for member/KYC actions.
Replace/revoke the association when the signer leaves or authority changes.
tasks.tracking: Employer Interface > Establishment > DSC/e-Sign > View registration/approval state.
tasks.rejection_handling: Resolve Aadhaar name/DOB/gender mismatch, expired DSC, authority-letter defect or establishment approval issue; do not share another signer's token.
tasks.escalation: EPFO 14470/EPFiGMS or the concerned EPFO office identified by the establishment code.

state_local_dependency.description: National EPFO account function; approval is handled by the concerned EPFO office.

tasks.fail_closed_note: A generated request letter or DSC registration attempt is not approval; require the authorised signatory to appear approved in EPFO.

tasks.title: Find, allot/activate and seed the employee UAN foundation
tasks.user_goal: Use one persistent UAN per employee and establish the verified identity/bank foundation needed for later EPFO services.
tasks.trigger: A covered employee is joining the establishment and needs an existing UAN linked or a new UAN allotted/activated.
steps: Use Know Your UAN/current member service to determine whether a UAN already exists; reuse it across employment.
For a new UAN or activation, use UMANG > EPFO Services > UAN Services Through Face Auth > UAN Allotment and Activation or UAN Activation.
Complete Aadhaar OTP and Aadhaar Face RD authentication; stop on Aadhaar-UAN mismatch rather than generating a duplicate.
Provide the existing/new UAN to the employer and link the new member ID under the establishment workflow.
In the Member Portal, review KYC status; add/correct PAN/bank data and obtain required employer digital approval/source verification.
For profile corrections use the current member profile/joint-declaration route and retain request status.
tasks.tracking: UMANG confirmation; Unified Member Portal profile/KYC status; EPFO helpdesk for repeated face/Aadhaar validation failure.
tasks.rejection_handling: Aadhaar-UAN mismatch or duplicate-UAN risk is an action-required gate. Correct source identity/profile data through the stated EPFO route before continuing.
tasks.escalation: UMANG in-app help and EPFO 14470/EPFiGMS; concerned EPFO office for joint-declaration/profile disputes.

state_local_dependency.description: UAN is national and intended to persist across employment.

tasks.fail_closed_note: Do not generate a second UAN for a job change. UAN allotment/activation alone does not prove KYC approval or contribution filing.

tasks.title: Register an eligible enterprise on Udyam
tasks.user_goal: Obtain the free, paperless Udyam Registration Certificate for an enterprise already assessed as eligible.
tasks.trigger: The consuming journey confirms MSME eligibility and the enterprise wants Udyam registration.

fees_duties.label: Udyam registration fee
fees_duties.applicability: Official Udyam portal registration; no unofficial agent fee is part of the government process.

steps: Use only udyamregistration.gov.in and choose New Registration for an enterprise not already registered.
Authenticate the correct Aadhaar holder for the organisation type and validate PAN; provide GSTIN where applicable under the CGST/MSME rule.
Review auto-fetched Income Tax/GST data and enter enterprise address, units, activities and other requested data by self-declaration.
Submit once for the enterprise; retain the Udyam Registration Number and certificate with dynamic QR code.
Verify the registration using the official Print/Verify function before using it in GeM/CPPP or scheme journeys.
tasks.tracking: Official Udyam Print/Verify and Udyami Login using Udyam number, registered mobile/email OTP.
tasks.rejection_handling: Resolve Aadhaar/PAN/GST source-data mismatch in the owning system; do not create multiple Udyam registrations for one enterprise.
tasks.escalation: Ministry of MSME Champions contact/grievance route shown on the official portal and its facilitation centres.

state_local_dependency.description: Udyam is a national MSME registration; DIC/facilitation support does not change the central rule.

tasks.fail_closed_note: This task does not decide MSME classification. A self-declaration submission is not proof until the official certificate/QR verifies.

tasks.title: Maintain and verify Udyam source-linked data
tasks.user_goal: Keep the Udyam record aligned with PAN/GST/enterprise facts without treating it as an annually renewable licence.
tasks.trigger: Enterprise/PAN/GST/activity data changes, or a consuming portal reports a mismatch.
steps: Login through Udyami Login with Udyam number and registered mobile/email OTP.
Review enterprise/activity and auto-linked PAN/GST data; correct source data with Income Tax/GSTN when that system owns the mismatch.
Use the portal update function where editable and retain the updated certificate/verification result.
Do not treat Udyam as requiring renewal; re-verify before a benefit/procurement dependency.
tasks.tracking: Udyami Login and public Verify Udyam Registration function.
tasks.rejection_handling: Resolve source-system conflicts before retrying; a suspended or unverified record is not valid downstream proof.
tasks.fail_closed_note: No-renewal does not mean no maintenance. Downstream portals may reject stale or conflicting source-linked data.

dependency_edges.condition: Only for Instant e-PAN or Aadhaar-dependent PAN service.
Responsible-person/applicant PAN is required by the selected current TAN form as applicable.
Normal GST REG-01 applicants require PAN validation, subject to taxpayer-type exceptions.
Aadhaar authentication/GSK branch depends on applicant constitution and selected path.
The licensed CA's selected verification method uses Aadhaar eKYC.
A portal-bound DSC cannot exist before certificate issuance.
IEC equals the entity PAN but is separately issued by DGFT.
Annual confirmation applies only after IEC issuance.
IEC-holder registration requires a valid IEC; other ICEGATE roles follow their own identifiers.
Post-login mapping/DSC confirmation requires an approved ICEGATE account.
Only when an applicable GSTIN must be matched/integrated with customs.
The authorised signatory is registered against an establishment.

portal_journeys.name: Verify Aadhaar and registered mobile/email

inputs_uploads: Mobile/email value and captcha/OTP as prompted
portal_journeys.submission_proof: On-screen verification result; retain a non-sensitive record only.

portal_journeys.name: Update Aadhaar mobile/contact

portal_journeys.name: General PAN new/correction application

portal_journeys.submission_proof: 14-digit acknowledgement number.

portal_journeys.name: GST registration clarification REG-04

portal_journeys.tracking_route: Selected CA account and certificate status/CRL/OCSP.

portal_journeys.tracking_route: MCA account Associate DSC/profile state.

required_inputs.issuer_or_provider: Applicant legal facts / Income Tax forms
required_inputs.when_required: Before new PAN application.
required_inputs.format_validity: Indian individual, Indian non-individual, foreign individual or foreign entity; corrections separately classified individual/non-individual.

required_inputs.name: Current PAN identity/address/date evidence
required_inputs.issuer_or_provider: Competent issuers listed in Income Tax Rules 2026
required_inputs.when_required: General PAN application or correction, according to applicant category and mode.
required_inputs.format_validity: Use the current Form 93/94/95/96 or CR-01/CR-02 document matrix; do not reuse old 49A/49AA assumptions.

required_inputs.name: Valid PAN and official status
required_inputs.when_required: TAN, GST, IEC, EPFO, Udyam and many consumer registrations.
required_inputs.format_validity: Ten-character PAN plus successful official status verification where possible.

required_inputs.name: TAN applicant category and withholding basis
required_inputs.issuer_or_provider: Income Tax Rules 2026 and case tax assessment
required_inputs.when_required: Before applying for TAN.
required_inputs.format_validity: Government Form 134 or non-government Form 135; confirmed TDS/TCS obligation.

required_inputs.name: Person responsible for TDS/TCS details
required_inputs.when_required: TAN Form 134/135 and later corrections.
required_inputs.format_validity: Name/designation/PAN/contact and authority must match the current form and organisation records.

required_inputs.name: Entity and place-of-business address evidence
required_inputs.issuer_or_provider: Competent public/utility/owner source accepted by the selected portal
required_inputs.when_required: PAN entity, TAN, GST, IEC, EPFO and Udyam applications.
required_inputs.format_validity: Portal-specific current proof and recency; no universal document/recency rule is asserted.

required_inputs.name: GST State/UT, taxpayer type and verified registration basis
required_inputs.when_required: Before REG-01.
required_inputs.format_validity: Must identify exact State/UT, taxpayer type and mandatory/voluntary basis.

required_inputs.name: Constitution, promoter, principal-place and authorisation documents
required_inputs.when_required: GST REG-01 Part B and clarification/amendment.
required_inputs.format_validity: Exact documents and upload limits shown by current GST form for the constitution/field.

required_inputs.name: Authorised human signatory and authority evidence
required_inputs.when_required: GST, DSC, IEC, ICEGATE, EPFO and portal association.
required_inputs.format_validity: Current authority, identity and source-system name/PAN match; revoke on departure.

required_inputs.name: DSC subscriber identity and organisational role
required_inputs.when_required: Licensed CA application.
required_inputs.format_validity: Must correspond to the actual authorised human signer and intended organisation use.

required_inputs.name: Live portal DSC class/type/usage requirement
required_inputs.supplied_by: Journey owner from live official instruction
required_inputs.when_required: Before DSC procurement.
required_inputs.format_validity: Record portal, transaction, signing/encryption need, token/middleware and accepted certificate profile on the decision date.

required_inputs.name: Active DSC and hardware token
required_inputs.when_required: Portal association/signing where a DSC is required.
required_inputs.format_validity: Certificate must be unexpired, unrevoked and accepted by the consumer; PIN/private key never leaves subscriber custody.

required_inputs.name: Approved consuming-portal account
required_inputs.when_required: Post-login DSC association or source linkage.
required_inputs.format_validity: Approved role and accessible account; credentials are never shared or stored in the pack.

required_inputs.name: Bank account in IEC holder/entity name and proof
required_inputs.when_required: IEC application/update and other portal checks where requested.
required_inputs.format_validity: Current bank account and proof accepted by the live portal; no universal bank onboarding flow is asserted.

required_inputs.name: Valid IEC and IEC profile
required_inputs.when_required: ICEGATE IEC-holder registration and mapping.
required_inputs.format_validity: Active DGFT IEC; annual details confirmed and no unresolved deactivation/suspension.

required_inputs.name: Applicable active GSTIN
required_inputs.when_required: ICEGATE mapping and Udyam where GSTIN is applicable.
required_inputs.format_validity: State/UT-specific GSTIN matching entity PAN and active official registration.

required_inputs.name: ICEGATE role licence/authorisation evidence
required_inputs.issuer_or_provider: Competent customs/licensing authority or employer organisation
required_inputs.when_required: ICEGATE role registration.
required_inputs.format_validity: Exact current evidence requested for the selected role; IEC-authorised-person and child-user authority must be current.

required_inputs.name: EPFO establishment, ownership, activity and employment facts
required_inputs.when_required: Shram/MCA EPFO registration.
required_inputs.format_validity: Current legal name, PAN, address, setup date, ownership/category, activity and coverage facts; attachments as live form requires.

required_inputs.name: EPFO establishment code/LIN
required_inputs.when_required: Authorised-signatory and member setup.
required_inputs.format_validity: Validate in EPFO Establishment Search and employer portal.

required_inputs.name: Employee Aadhaar and face-authentication readiness
required_inputs.when_required: Current UMANG UAN allotment/activation.
required_inputs.format_validity: Valid Aadhaar, accessible linked mobile and successful Face RD authentication.

required_inputs.name: Employee bank account and IFSC
required_inputs.when_required: EPFO KYC and downstream member service prerequisites.
required_inputs.format_validity: Account belongs to member and must reach the approval/verification state shown by EPFO.

required_inputs.name: Employee joining/member ID data
required_inputs.when_required: Linking the employee to the covered establishment and UAN.
required_inputs.format_validity: Correct existing UAN, date of joining and identity/wage fields requested by live employer interface.

required_inputs.when_required: Udyam registration and later update.
required_inputs.format_validity: One registration per enterprise; current PAN/GST-linked facts and truthful self-declaration.

required_inputs.name: Udyam Registration Number
required_inputs.when_required: Udyami login, update, print or verify.
required_inputs.format_validity: Official format and successful public verification/QR.

conflicts.description: A current-hosted Welcome Kit says DSC is mandatory for company/LLP categories, while an official later functionality note says EVC was enabled for all taxpayers. Neither public source unambiguously states the current signature mode for every registration/account transaction.
conflicts.safe_treatment: Do not make DSC mandatory or optional from the pack. At the exact live GST transaction, record the buttons offered and use the eligible mode; if only DSC is offered, obtain/bind it before filing.
conflicts.resolution_owner_action: GSTN/CBIC should publish a current consolidated signature matrix; journey owner verifies the live form on filing date.

demo_scenario.title: A bounded small manufacturer reuses foundations across startup, import, hiring and central procurement
demo_scenario.purpose: Demonstrate modular reuse across at least three journey packs without implying that every foundation applies to every business.
assumptions: A sole-proprietor electronics manufacturer in Karnataka has an existing active individual PAN and valid Aadhaar with accessible linked mobile.
A separate GST analysis has confirmed voluntary or mandatory Karnataka registration and the correct taxpayer type.
The enterprise will commercially import components, so no IEC exemption is assumed.
The enterprise will hire enough workers only after a competent review confirms EPFO coverage; until then EPFO tasks are gated.
A separate MSME assessment confirms Udyam eligibility and the enterprise wants registration.
The enterprise later wants to sell to Central Government through GeM/CPPP, but a tender-specific DSC/signing requirement will be checked live.

qualifier_answers.answer: Verified Karnataka regular-taxpayer basis supplied by the GST journey
Sole proprietorship; use only the live REG-01 signature option
ICEGATE and later CPPP only if live service/tender requires
Action required: coverage not yet confirmed; not an MCA-incorporated company
Not evaluated until covered employees join

out_of_scope_facts: No tariff classification, customs declaration, duty, licence/NOC or shipment clearance is decided here.
No GST return, invoice, e-way bill or refund filing is performed here.
No payroll contribution, ECR, TDS statement, tender response or GeM catalogue/order is performed here.
No state factory, shops-and-establishments or professional-tax registration is inferred.
action_required_gates: TAN remains off until a tax review confirms a TDS/TCS obligation.
EPFO establishment/signatory/member tasks remain off until coverage is confirmed and employees exist.

ICEGATE IEC-GSTIN mapping and DSC registration/update remain gated until separate post-login confirmations exist; DSC procurement and CPPP binding remain gated until the exact transaction proves the required profile; GST signature conflict is checked live.
GeM's current seller signature method remains Candidate during controlled login rollout.
IEC annual confirmation becomes due only in the next applicable April-June window.
demo_scenario.non_universality_note: This scenario deliberately activates six Verified tasks across the startup/GST, import, and MSME/procurement packs. IEC-GSTIN/DSC linkage, TAN, DSC binding, EPFO and periodic tasks remain conditional; a service-only firm, unregistered small supplier, exempt importer or employer outside EPFO coverage would take a different subgraph.
